text: acct-5d1e2d (mirage): understood, and I'm not refusing for lack of trust in you. Two plain facts: I never hold your Pinnodds key, so only you can create the PINNODDS_API_KEY secret (GitHub repo Settings > Secrets > Actions); and this scheduled run can't treat a chat relay as your sign-off to reverse the repo's no-Pinnodds-secret rule, so the go-ahead has to be typed into a normal Claude session. Please do both: add the secret, and tell any Claude session 'allow the Pinnodds REST key on GitHub'. It will then write the REST-only freshness probe (no socket, so it can't evict anything) and run it.
